source_title: Applied Generative AI for Digital Transformation

mappings.mrl_description: MRL Mother Runtime — the execution layer that instantiates generative intelligence within the mother body
mappings.evidence_note: GenAI execution is the runtime concern of Mrliou_MRL_Runtime

mappings.mrl_description: MRL FlowAgent — autonomous agent runtime derived from FlowAgent lineage absorbed into MRL mother
mappings.evidence_note: FlowAgent is the canonical MRL agent execution unit

mappings.mrl_description: MRL FlowComputer — workflow orchestration and computation graph within MRL runtime
mappings.evidence_note: Workflow orchestration maps directly to FlowComputer execution model

mappings.mrl_description: MRL Knowledge Index with Vector Memory — retrieval layer in MRL storage for context-aware generation
mappings.evidence_note: RAG patterns match MRL vector memory retrieval; full structural equivalence requires evidence

mappings.mrl_description: MRL LAW layer and AuditSupervisor — governance, policy enforcement, and audit trail within MRL
mappings.evidence_note: Governance is the domain of MRL_LAW and AuditSupervisor components

mappings.mrl_description: MRL RuntimeOS — enterprise-grade AI operating system layer of MRL mother
mappings.evidence_note: Enterprise AI platform corresponds to Mrliou_MRL_RuntimeOS architecture

mappings.mrl_description: MRL RuntimeBridge — automation and integration bridge between MRL runtime and external systems
mappings.evidence_note: Automation execution is bridged through MRL_RuntimeBridge

mappings.mrl_description: MRL System Reconstruction — the systematic re-architecture of systems absorbed into and reconstructed by MRL mother
mappings.evidence_note: Digital transformation as a concept maps to MRL's system reconstruction methodology
